result_blind_statement: No R1 output existed when this file was frozen. August exploratory outputs (prototype/results/*.csv) were visible to the designer; where an R1 analysis was added because of an observed exploratory pattern, it is labelled POST_HOC below.

PC03.label: PRESPECIFIED_SYNTHETIC_SIMULATION_NONINDEPENDENT_METHODS_REVIEW
PC03.blocks: 32 primary blocks x 4096 draws per cell; reserve blocks 33-36 used only to replace a block that fails to execute; a completed unfavourable block is never replaced
PC03.rng: Python random.Random(seed) per block, seed from pc03-seed-schedule.csv

policies.stratified: fixed quota of 2 members per domain (4 domains x 2), uniformly within domain

RID-C003-STRAT-001.pairing: common random numbers: one failure state per draw; RNG state snapshotted after the failure draw and restored before each policy's sample; policy evaluation order alternates by draw-index parity
RID-C003-STRAT-001.primary_endpoint: per-draw difference D = Z_strat - Z_unif where Z = 1[catastrophic AND audit fails] (unconditional detected-catastrophe indicator); estimand E[D]
secondary_endpoints: conditional detection difference among catastrophic draws
audit-pass difference over all draws (benign alarm cost)
RID-C003-STRAT-001.precision_target: Hoeffding absolute half-width <= 0.010 on D in [-1,1]
RID-C003-STRAT-001.note: Fixed quota 2-per-domain follows the analysis-plan wording 'fixed-quota stratified sampling'. The August exploratory sweep used one-per-domain plus uniform remainder; that implementation is not the R1 primary.

RID-C003-SW-001.withholder_identity: members with zero-based index 21..31 (spread over all four domains by index mod 4)
RID-C003-SW-001.primary_endpoint: per-draw gap G = audit_pass - dispute_success; estimand E[G]; reported regardless of direction

excluded.RID-C003-CORR-001: remains excluded as a confirmatory family; correlated behaviour is reported only through the ANALYTIC_DOMAIN family below
excluded.RID-C003-DEADLINE-001: superseded for R1 by the EMULATED_DEADLINE family below, which is labelled single-host emulation

ANALYTIC_DOMAIN.label: EXACT_ANALYTIC_DECLARED_SYNTHETIC_MODEL

models.IID: each member independently unavailable with probability f
models.DOMAIN_4x8: 4 domains of 8; each domain independently fails with probability f; no other failures
models.DOMAIN_2x16: 2 domains of 16 (violates placement cap n-t=10); each domain fails with probability f
models.DOMAIN_8x4: 8 domains of 4; each domain fails with probability f

outputs: exact uniform audit pass P[all s sampled ready]
ANALYTIC_DOMAIN.monte_carlo_cross_check: 20000 draws at f in {0.10, 0.20} per model, seeds 20261009 + model index, used only to validate the exact code
ANALYTIC_DOMAIN.claim_boundary: Domain labels and independence are assumptions; no claim about real provider or region behaviour.

ANALYTIC_ACCEPTANCE_SENSITIVITY.label: POST_HOC_EXACT_ANALYTIC
ANALYTIC_ACCEPTANCE_SENSITIVITY.post_hoc_reason: The August IID sweep showed that s=q=8 audits fail benignly in about 56% of draws at 10% IID unavailability while reconstruction still succeeds. This trade-off analysis was added after seeing that pattern.
outputs: benign audit pass under IID f in {0.05, 0.10, 0.20}

SCALABILITY.label: EXACT_ANALYTIC_PLUS_LOCAL_MICROBENCHMARK

groups.keystone-safe-prime-256-v1: prototype research group (NOT a secure size; reference only)
groups.ffdhe2048: RFC 7919 safe prime, q=(p-1)/2, generator 4 of the order-q subgroup; parameters from OpenSSL 3.6.5, file ffdhe2048.pem
groups.ffdhe3072: RFC 7919 safe prime, as above, file ffdhe3072.pem

microbenchmarks.statistic: median and p95 wall time, time.perf_counter, single process, CPython 3.13.13, Apple M4 Pro

SCALABILITY.message_sizes: canonical AuditRequestTranscript and PartialResponseTranscript byte lengths per group; audit bandwidth = 1 request broadcast + s responses; dispute bandwidth = n requests + t responses
SCALABILITY.implementation_boundary: pure-Python reference implementation; timings are an upper bound on compute cost, not optimized-library performance

EMULATED_DEADLINE.label: SINGLE_HOST_EMULATION_REAL_CRYPTO_NOT_FIELD_DATA
EMULATED_DEADLINE.host: one Apple M4 Pro (12 cores), macOS 15.1, CPython 3.13.13

committee.keygen: dealer keygen once per profile run

EMULATED_DEADLINE.topology: 32 custodian OS processes, each an asyncio TCP server on 127.0.0.1 holding only its own share; one combiner process (asyncio client) that issues requests, verifies DLEQ proofs as responses arrive, stops at t valid, combines, unwraps the record key and AES-GCM-decrypts
EMULATED_DEADLINE.network_emulation: one-way delay per message drawn by the combiner-side emulator from the trace seed and passed as out-of-band emulation metadata; the custodian sleeps the inbound delay before computing and the outbound delay before replying; lost messages are never answered; no retransmission
EMULATED_DEADLINE.delay_model: lognormal one-way delay with stated median and sigma (log-space); 0 means no injected delay
EMULATED_DEADLINE.trace: each trace = one routine audit (uniform s=8, q=8, beacon-derived canary) then one authorized dispute over a freshly sealed 1 KiB record
EMULATED_DEADLINE.primary_endpoint: P[dispute completes with correct plaintext by deadline 2.0 s] per profile
EMULATED_DEADLINE.crash_selection: crashed members chosen uniformly per trace from the trace seed; domain outage = one domain chosen uniformly per trace, all 8 members silent
EMULATED_DEADLINE.interval_method: Wilson 95% for proportions; order-statistic quantiles for times
EMULATED_DEADLINE.claim_boundary: Delay parameters are declared synthetic profiles, not measured internet paths. Same-host scheduling, loopback TCP and CPU sharing differ from a geo-distributed deployment.

deviation_rule: Any change after the first R1 run is appended to research-case/03-design/r1-reviewer-revision/r1-deviation-log.md with reason and time; the frozen file is not edited.
